name: Torna Fort (Prachandagad)
tagline: The first fort Shivaji Maharaj ever captured — and Pune district's tallest
seoTitle: Torna Fort Solo Trek Guide — The Solo Trail
seoDescription: Solo trekker's guide to Torna Fort near Pune — the tallest fort in Pune district, the Rajgad-Torna range trek, safety, and packing.

seasons.label: Jun – Sep
seasons.sub: Monsoon — green ridgeline, watch footing on wet rock

routeOptions.name: Via Velhe
routeOptions.notes: The standard approach — Velhe itself sits at ~700m so the net gain is manageable, but the trail is steep in patches.

safety.intro: Torna is often paired with Rajgad as a 2-day range trek — a genuinely committing outing, not a casual add-on.

cards.title: Before you go
items: If attempting the Rajgad-Torna range trek, arrange camping/stay logistics before you start — this isn't a same-day there-and-back
Confirm water source status with recent trekker reports

cards.title: On the trail
items: Steep sections near the fort entrance need careful footing, especially wet
Fort complex is large — pace yourself if also planning the range trek to Rajgad

cards.title: Solo-specific
items: Less crowded than Rajgad/Sinhagad — tell someone your plan since you may be more alone here
Carry extra water — fewer trekkers means fewer people to flag down if needed

items.name: Layered clothing — Velhe base to summit has a noticeable temperature drop
3L water for a full range-trek day
Camping gear if doing the Rajgad-Torna overnight range trek
